text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT - HIGH - p99 latency breach on /v1/generate (us-west1). Trigger: p99 > 10s for 5m. Incident INC-4219. Paging @oncall-rotation. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-4219
sam: Acked. I'm taking ownership.
jess: seeing p95 ~ 1.8s -> p99 ~ 12.4s across traces, tail token latencies spike. Affects dedicated + shared clusters in us-west1.
sam: any recent model or infra changes?
lee: deploy-bot shows model-service canary rolled 28m ago (tag: model-2026-03-17-rc2). KV cache miss rate jumped to ~60% on edge routers.
maria: customer impact: support flagged 4 early-access customers experiencing timeouts in UI calls (>15s). CS alerted.
sam: quick triage: is this cold KV cache after canary? also check batching behavior + continuous batching config.
jess: logs: `ERROR: request_timeout for token_stream` on heavy-context requests. Batching latency distribution shifted right.
sam: mitigation plan: 1) route some traffic to smaller quantized variant, 2) scale up dedicated pool in us-west, 3) warm KV cache. Doing step 1 now.
ops-bot: Autoscaler: requested +8 GPUs to dedicated pool us-west1-d. ETA ~90s.
sam: switching routing: updating weight -> redwood-xl-512q gets 70%, redwood-xl-1024q 30%. Command: `rtctl route update --service=model-service --policy=latency-fallback --weights 512q=70,1024q=30`
jess: applied. hitting the route change. Initial p99 dropped to 7.2s.
lee: prefetch job kicked to warm KV hot prefixes: `kv-prefetch --prefix-file /tmp/hot_prefixes.txt --region us-west1`
maria: sending customer bulletin to affected accounts: short note + ETA. patch in #support ready to send. support-bot: Draft queued.
sam: step 2 autoscaler reported nodes ready, scheduling traffic onto new pool.
ops-bot: Dedicated pool scaled, nodes JOINED: 8 gpus healthy.
jess: seeing further improvement: p99 -> 3.9s, p95 -> 1.5s. Heatmap shows fewer long tails.
lee: KV miss rate trending down to 10% after prefetch.
maria: CS confirms one customer saw recovery in UI within 2m of bulletin. others report reduced errors.
sam: step 3 verification: running synthetic quickchecks across 5k requests: p99 ~2.6s, error rate back to baseline.
jess: also toggled continuous batching cap from 64 -> 32 for heavy-context to reduce token serialization delays.
oncall-rotation: handoff note for night oncall (@lee at 19:00 PT): INC-4219 mitigation steps, rollback candidate tag model-2026-03-16-stable, routing weight changes recorded in runbook.
sam: leaving notes in incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/INC-4219 (summary + graphs).
support-bot: Customer bulletin sent to affected accounts with link to status page.
jess: monitoring for 10m window before close. If p99 < 3s for 5m we'll resolve.
sam: p99 stable 2.4s for 7m, errors normalized. Marking as resolved in PagerDuty.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-4219 marked RESOLVED by sam.
sam: closing thread — will follow up with RCA tomorrow (likely Canary caused cold KV + batching interaction). :white_check_mark:
